with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as handle:
                handle.write(self.token)
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
evidence.reason: The admission hold is explicitly treated as a persisted marker whose token proves ownership and whose retention blocks admission after failure, but the acquire path only fsyncs the token file descriptor. It never fsyncs the marker's parent directory after the O_CREAT|O_EXCL directory entry is created, so the entry can be lost on power loss and the hold can silently disappear; the same durability gap applies to the removal path. This is an implementation defect in the existing persistence/recovery behavior, not a new requirement.
